widgets_values:
ONE WORKFLOW FOR EVERY CASE

Source: an image or a clip (Load Source). An image runs the stills branch only; a clip runs SAM 3 through the keyframe frame's shot, the stills branch on the keyframe frame, then Refine (Video) on that shot, spliced back into the clip. An edit with several shots: the Shot node finds the cuts round the keyframe frame (or set its start and end); run each product's shot, then the next product on the output.

Packshot: the real product photo.
Product mask: (none) = SAM 3 with the prompt; or a mask file (white = product; a clip: one per frame).
Corrected keyframe (clips): (none) = the stills branch makes it; or a frame fixed elsewhere.
Fix this product: false = the product looks fine on the triage sheet: only SAM 3 on the keyframe frame and the sheet run.
Job JSON: empty = Auto Draft from its inputs; or a measured job.
Keyframe frame (clips): the frame the stills branch fixes, from 0.
Refine settings JSON and product copy (clips).
SAM 3 prompt: the product, e.g. 'pump bottle'.
Straighten: Image Reframe's frame and rotation (all 0: off).
Print type: Auto Draft's ink (off: a paper label, or print on paper or a flat panel; light or dark: print straight on a round body, lighter or darker than it, with no paper; dark also snaps the print onto the generated print).

Outputs: the refined image (a clip: the refined keyframe), QA sheets and report.json (QA Sheet's text); for a clip, the lossless master (.mov), the mp4 review copy, the QA plot and the Refine report.

Only the needed branch runs: Switch and Run If nodes skip the rest.
